sources.title: 6.0 Structures, Materials, and Mechanisms
sources.authors: NASA Small Spacecraft Systems Virtual Institute
sources.access_depth: Official HTML, section 6.3.2 Deployable Structures, lines 512–528
sources.source_type: government technical review of adjacent-domain structures
sources.claim: NASA列举折叠、套筒、桁架、充气和可卷复合材料支撑结构，可为紧凑收纳摄影臂提供机构启发。
sources.limits: 航天部署条件不是人体穿戴、低温结冰、摔倒冲击或反复收放验证；原页面也声明部分厂商性能未经独立验证。不能移植其可靠性或材料优越性数值。
